adapter_targets.integration_requirement: Use central gate status as a required gate reference before model-call or apply paths.
adapter_targets.real_flow_prepared: Source Proxy model-call and apply central gate

adapter_targets.integration_requirement: Use spend-before-send preview for paid provider/model routes.
Treat approved action execution as outside preview authority; require explicit approval and verification.
Map unsafe path findings to blocked executive preview decisions.
Ensure worker/provider recommendations do not grant approval/apply/commit/push authority.
Keep executive preview compatible with existing /coding approval gate UI states.

phase_5_handoff_requirements: Worker selector must consume permission_decision and risk_classes.
Worker selector must not select execution when permission_decision is blocked, needs_clarification, or unverified_gate.
Provider/model selection is recommendation-only unless a later phase approves calls.
No worker can approve its own action.
Fake-green and truth-contract risk must be carried into verifier planning.
Spend/provider gates must remain separate from capability matching.
